buySellOrder.question: Is there a specific order to buying and selling on your turn?
buySellOrder.answer: Sell then buy, or buy then sell.

firstSellRound.question: When can you first sell shares in a company?
firstSellRound.answer: From the second stock round onwards.

firstStationTiming.question: When is a company's first station marker laid?
firstStationTiming.answer: At the start of the game. 1865 Sardinia All base station tokens start the game on the map. For absorbed companies re-entering the game the home base is placed when the President's certificate is purchased.

maxRevenue.question: Must the maximum possible revenue be claimed?
maxRevenue.answer: Yes. Players are not required to point out a higher revenue total than that claimed.

miscellaneous.question: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.answer: There are no private companies. An initial auction starts the game, in which the President's certificate of the Northern Pacific is sold by auction. Company start locations have no value. If a company uses its start location as part of a route, the value of the highest income town or city is doubled. There is no trade-in price for Diesels. All Diesels cost $1,100.
